( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 10 July 1984, after the tlraft finalized by the Methods of Physical Tests Sectional Committee had ken approved by the Structural and Metals Division Council.

0.2 This standard was first published in 1974 and coverecl the requirements of scleroscope hardness testing machines and their \,erification. Now the requirements of the sclerosope testing machines inclrlding the method of conducting scleroscope hardness test have been coveied in IS : 7096 So the Sectional Cnmmittee decided to revise this standard 1981*. incorporating only the method for verification tsf scleroscope hardness testing machines and also to change the title of the standard accordingly. 0.3 In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been ` Standard derived from ASTM E 448-72 ( Reapproved 1377 ) recommended practice for scleroscope hardness testing of metallic by American Society for Testing and Materials. materials `, Issued *
1. SCOPE
